question: The amount of radiation emitted by a radioactive material is measured using the conventional unit ________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**curie.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Curie (Ci)** is a unit for **measuring radiation **emitted by radioactive material. It is used in the** US system of units. **
 
• The **System International of units** (SI system) uses the **unit of becquerel (Bq) **as its unit of** radioactivity.**
 
• **One Curie is 37 billion Bq.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Watt**- It is the SI unit of power. 
 
• **Ampere**- It is the SI unit of electric current. 
 
• **Pascal**- It is the SI unit of pressure.
